svg.title: What the hash chain lets through and what the signer catches
svg.text: Hashes prove consistency. The signer's record proves nothing was cut.
a tampered copy of the ledger
remove an event from the middle
a checkpoint through event 6 was signed; events removed
change a verdict, recompute every hash
the checkpoint's hash no longer matches
the same, then re-sign every checkpoint with a new key
the same, and replace the public-key file beside the ledger;
a public key stored next to
what it verifies is not a check
cost: 0.88 ms to sign, 0.16 ms to verify, 5 to 11 ms per checkpoint; signing is not what limits how often to checkpoint
so: record the signer's key id and the latest checkpoint's hash somewhere the writer cannot reach
